name: Zoho Procurement
summary: Zoho Procurement charges per user, at $35 a month on Premium and $75 on Enterprise, billed annually, with a 14-day trial. Each paid user license includes 50 free requester licenses for staff who only raise purchase requests. Single sign-on starts on Enterprise.

facts.text: Zoho says employees can submit ad hoc and catalog purchase requests, and that purchase orders are generated automatically from approved requests and RFQs.
Both plans include supplier onboarding, a self-service vendor portal, product catalog management and purchase order management.
Custom approval workflows, single sign-on, contract management and RFx sourcing are listed on Enterprise, and Premium has basic approvals.
The product page names Amazon Business punch-in and punch-out as its integration with an external marketplace.
Each purchased user license includes 50 free requester licenses, and the FAQ says the 14-day trial needs no credit card.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually. Basic approvals, supplier onboarding and vendor portal, catalogs and purchase orders

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually. Adds custom approval workflows, single sign-on, contract management and RFx sourcing

hiddenCosts: The page shows a dollar sign without naming the currency, and Zoho shows prices by location, so the figure a buyer sees can differ.
Only annual prices are shown, so no monthly-billing rate is known.
Several Enterprise items, such as supplier scoring and blanket purchase orders, are marked coming soon.
